worked_solution:
For expressions involving subtraction, De Moivre's theorem states that

$$
{[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\phi )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\phi )]}^{n}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\phi )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(n\phi ).
$$

In our expression, we have $n=6$ and $\phi =\theta .$ Substituting in these values, we get

$$
[\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta -\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ]^{6}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(6\theta )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(6\theta ).
$$
